# ADR-3257: AWS root_mfa: Root MFA required key for account 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unprotected root can destroy the account.

## Decision

Accounts MUST enforce a root MFA required key for account 1 (AWS-root_mfa-1).

## Consequences

Root credentials stay vaulted offline.
